2608.30678.title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding
2608.30678.paper_summary: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.
2608.30678.paper_summary_zh: 文本豐富的圖像理解需要多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）來組織基於光學字符識別（OCR）的證據，這些證據涉及單詞、佈局、領域、圖表和視覺對應。現有的評估常常將提取與推理混為一談，並且很少測試模型是否遵循所需的推理方向：應用可見規則、抽象隱藏的規律或恢復缺失的前提。我們介紹了OCR-MetaReasoning，一個受控的單圖像基準，將演繹、歸納和推斷視為不同的方向，並將最終答案的正確性與推理過程的合規性分開。該基準包含1,500個經過驗證的樣本，採用平衡的\(3\times5\)分類法，涵蓋三種推理類型和五種OCR對象類別，並附有參考推理步驟、自動答案評分、Meta-Reasoning Macro Score（MRMS）和Reasoning Process Compliance Score（RPCS）。對具有代表性的封閉源和開放源MLLM的實驗顯示，基於OCR的元推理仍然遠未飽和：模型在可見規則的應用和佈局敏感推理方面掙扎，而過程合規的理由在精確匹配評估下可能伴隨不正確的最終答案。代碼可在https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning獲得。
